# Svalin Industries

> Svalin Industries is a dual-use technology company. Its product is ORCA (Operational Research, Coordination & Assessment), a simulation environment for drone swarms and autonomous systems across air, land, sea and subsea. ORCA is used to test, validate and rehearse critical operations before anything flies. Simulate. Validate. Advance.

## Pages
- [Home](https://svalinindustries.com/): what ORCA is, its four main uses (C-UAS red teaming, autonomy testing, mission rehearsal, operator training), why simulation, defence and civil markets, FAQ and contact.
- [ORCA](https://svalinindustries.com/simulator.html): the simulation engine in detail: anatomy of an agent, field trial versus simulation, layered C-UAS defence and metrics per run, 18 use cases, capabilities and architecture.
- [Developers](https://svalinindustries.com/developers.html): for teams building drones, autonomy software or counter-drone systems: threat injection, software- and hardware-in-the-loop (SIL / HIL) integration, API / SDK, metrics per run and access options.
- [Industry](https://svalinindustries.com/civil.html): ORCA for civil operators: perimeter security, energy networks, ports and maritime operations, emergency response, agriculture and large estates, drone autonomy testing.
- [Legal Notice](https://svalinindustries.com/legal.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://svalinindustries.com/privacy.html)

## Key facts
- Product: ORCA, operational and ready to deploy.
- Domains: aerial, ground, surface and underwater agents in one scenario.
- Simulates: flight dynamics, sensors (radar, RF, EO/IR), communication links, electronic warfare (jamming, GNSS spoofing), terrain and weather.
- Every run is recorded, replayable with a fixed seed and comparable across builds and scenarios.
- Access: SaaS subscription, API / SDK, or on-premise deployment including air-gapped networks.
- Defence uses: C-UAS red teaming, third-party system validation, autonomy testing, mission rehearsal, operator training, wargaming, naval force protection.
- Civil uses: critical infrastructure protection, energy networks, ports, airports and events, emergency response and search and rescue, U-space integration, agriculture and commercial fleets.
- Simulations and metrics shown on the website are illustrative.
